verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical 320x50 strips. In both, '20% off' breaks onto two lines, the Solstice can is shrunk to an unreadable speck jammed against the button, the legal copy is microscopic and crammed against the right edge, and the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker is cut off from the headline and floats over the CTA, so the reading order is broken. A is marginally tidier because its kicker sits over the button, while B's kicker drifts left over the can and lines up with nothing.
